instructions.name: buy_gems
docs: Player pays SOL to the treasury and receives gems.

instructions.name: buy_item
docs: Player burns gems (fixed catalog price) and receives item units.

instructions.name: buy_item_sparks
docs: Player burns Sparks (the price of an account-bound item) and receives item units.

instructions.name: care
docs: Care strengthens bond and helps a well-rested Rebyter recover from bad conditions.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: claim_daily_ration
docs: Once per UTC day: mints the free ration (all four foods) to the player.

instructions.name: claim_quest
docs: Claims the Sparks of one of today's quests once the program has counted
enough of the matching actions (feed, play, care, rest, train) today.

instructions.name: create_item_type
docs: Registers an item mint (created client-side, 0 decimals, mint authority =
economy PDA). A NonTransferable mint makes the item account-bound
(the Sparks-purchasable version).

instructions.name: create_rebyter
docs: Creates a 1/1 Token-2022 Rebyter whose complete persistent game
state lives inside the mint account's TokenMetadata extension.
No per-Rebyter PDA account is created. The only asset/state account is
the mint itself, matching Rebyters' single-account design.

accounts.name: rebyter_authority
docs: second Rebyter account. It exists solely to sign Token-2022 metadata CPIs.

accounts.name: mint
docs: transaction and is the single account that stores Rebyter state.

accounts.name: rule_set
docs: unified active atlas root verifies both forms and gameplay rules.

instructions.name: feed
docs: Feed with one of four food groups: 0 meat, 1 plant, 2 fish, 3 fruit.

accounts.name: food_mint
docs: The free-to-trade mint of this food (the ration mint).

accounts.name: bound_food_mint
docs: The account-bound mint of this food.

accounts.name: owner_food
docs: Omit (null) when the wallet holds none of that food.

instructions.name: initialize_economy
docs: Creates the economy singleton. The gem mint is created client-side
(Token-2022, 0 decimals, NonTransferable, PermanentDelegate = economy
PDA, mint authority = economy PDA, no freeze authority) and validated here.

instructions.name: play
docs: Play builds bond and a little speed while consuming energy/fullness.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: rest
docs: Rest restores energy. It is not a cooldown: it is a player action and can
be used whenever desired, but it gives no stat farming advantage.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

instructions.name: set_bound_food
docs: Registers the four account-bound food mints (meat, plant, fish, fruit) that feeding burns
before the free-to-trade ones. Each must be a NonTransferable economy mint.

instructions.name: set_gem_pack
docs: Sets (or disables with zeros) a gem pack. Prices are in lamports.

instructions.name: set_ration
docs: Sets the four food mints given by the daily ration (meat, plant, fish, fruit)
and how many units of each. Zero units turns the ration off.

instructions.name: set_sparks_mint
docs: Registers the Sparks mint: Token-2022, 0 decimals, NonTransferable,
mint authority = economy PDA, no freeze authority.

instructions.name: train
docs: Train with one of six machines:
0 power, 1 endurance, 2 defense, 3 speed, 4 combat, 5 balanced.

accounts.name: player_profile
docs: The player's profile: counts the action for today's quests.

fields.name: spark_mint
docs: Non-transferable quest currency (default key until `set_sparks_mint`).

fields.name: ration_mints
docs: Foods of the free daily ration: meat, plant, fish, fruit.

fields.name: ration_units
docs: Units of each food in the ration; 0 = off.

fields.name: bound_mints
docs: Account-bound (Sparks-bought) mints of meat, plant, fish, fruit.

fields.name: bound
docs: True when the item mint is NonTransferable (account-bound version).

types.name: PlayerProfile
docs: The one per-wallet account: pokedex discoveries plus the small fixed-size daily state
(ration day, quest counters). Fixed fields come first; only `discoveries` ever grows.

fields.name: ration_day
docs: Game day of the last claimed ration (0 = never).

fields.name: quest_day
docs: Game day the counters below belong to.

fields.name: counts
docs: Actions done on `quest_day`: feed, play, care, rest, train (saturating).

fields.name: claimed
docs: Bit i set = quest slot i already claimed on `quest_day`.

fields.name: action
docs: 0 feed, 1 play, 2 care, 3 rest, 4 train.

fields.name: time_bucket
docs: 0 night, 1 morning, 2 day, 3 evening (UTC).
